purchasePathNote: Optimus Gen 1 was a 2022 prototype and was never sold. No Optimus version is on sale to the public yet.

faq.q: Can you buy Tesla Optimus Gen 1?
faq.a: No. Gen 1 was a prototype shown at Tesla AI Day 2022 and was replaced by later versions.

faq.q: How much will Tesla Optimus cost?
faq.a: Elon Musk has said Optimus will cost between $20,000 and $30,000 and that Tesla plans to sell it to the public by the end of 2027. This applies to future production versions, not Gen 1.

faq.q: Is any Tesla Optimus for sale now?
faq.a: No. As of September 2026 Tesla had not unveiled Optimus Gen 3 and was still installing its first Optimus production lines in Fremont, with no announced external sales.
